name: Protocol Reverse Engineering
description: Reverse engineering of network protocols and file formats from binary implementations or traffic captures. Covers traffic analysis, message structure recovery, state machine extraction, cryptographic protocol identification, and documentation of undocumented protocols.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to protocol reverse engineering

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands network protocols, serialization formats, and RE concepts
evidence: Can explain common serialization formats (protobuf, msgpack, ASN.1)
Familiar with Wireshark for traffic capture and analysis
Understands the concept of reverse engineering a protocol from traffic or binaries

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Analyzes simple protocols under supervision using traffic captures
evidence: Captured and analyzed protocol traffic using Wireshark
Identified message boundaries, fields, and basic structure in traffic
Correlated network traffic with application behavior

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently reverse engineers protocols to produce functional documentation
evidence: Independently reverse engineered protocols on 3+ engagements
Recovers message structures, field types, and state machines from traffic and binaries
Writes Wireshark dissectors or protocol parsers for reverse-engineered protocols
Passed proficiency assessment on protocol reverse engineering

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles encrypted and complex multi-stage protocols
evidence: Reverse engineers protocols with encryption by extracting keys via instrumentation
Recovers complex state machines with authentication and session management
Develops fuzzers targeting reverse-engineered protocol specifications
Mentors others on protocol RE methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on protocol reverse engineering; handles novel and complex protocols
evidence: Published research on reverse-engineered protocols or protocol vulnerabilities
Developed the lab's protocol RE methodology and tooling
Reverse engineers novel binary protocols with custom crypto and compression
Trains teams on protocol reverse engineering

assessment_methods.description: Given a traffic capture and client binary, reverse engineer the protocol and produce a specification document
Review of protocol documentation and dissector quality from recent engagements
